rv.q: It leaves you absolutely struck with horror.
Director Emma Rice returns in full force with a bloody twist on the so-called fairytale that combines political truth and heartbreak with a new sense of purpose

Beautifully choreographed movement, stylised stage combat, songs, projections, illusions, and excellent performances combine to make this a theatrical tour-de-force that one shouldn't miss for spectacle alone.
Blue Beard is a furious stance against femicide, and a production that will render many speechless.
